name: One Last Time
source:
A Visual novel about a girl named Yukiko or Yuki for short. She falls in love with her childhood friend Riku but is rejected and fell into a slight depression. But that all changed when she met him, he pushed away the dark gloomy clouds to reveal the bright gleaming sun. Who is this boy she met? Play to find out!

[From [url=https://cloudnovel.net/SoynaFloof/novel/one-last-time]Cloudnovel[/url]]
translation:
一部讲述少女雪子（昵称小雪）的视觉小说。她爱上了青梅竹马陆，却遭到拒绝，陷入轻度抑郁。然而，一次与那个男孩相遇后，一切都改变了：他驱散阴沉的乌云，展露出灿烂耀眼的太阳。他究竟是谁？进入游戏寻找答案吧！

（来源：[url=https://cloudnovel.net/SoynaFloof/novel/one-last-time]Cloudnovel[/url]）
